ops.body: Fixed by the v0.21.0 cut: worker/ and the named test are gone (top-level worker/, daemon/, wire/ deleted; the only surviving reference is the deliberate pre-cut mixed-era fixture). Gate verified the successor's structural core: the driver goroutine is settlement's sole executor, publishing one immutable Exit and closing c.settled exactly once (internal/proc/driver.go:199-208), so the old cancellation-vs-ErrClosed select race has no surface to occur on; the lane's own_test.go cites pin errScopeSettling ordering and spent-context precedence on the successor.
